fact_sheet_status.notes: Excel Col H blank, but matching public folder found in Drive master folder

official_name.value: Sciences Po (Institute d'Etudes Politiques de Paris)

min_standing_note.value: Undergraduate exchange: >=4 completed semesters of undergraduate study. Graduate exchange: Bachelor's degree or >=6 semesters of undergraduate study.

agreement_scope_raw.value: University-wide  for UG -GR must notify science po in advance on their field as choices are limited

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement_scope_raw states 'University-wide for UG - GR must notify science po in advance on their field as choices are limited'; UG is university-wide while GR is field-restricted and subject to advance Master programme placement.

eligible_majors.notes: UG exchange is University-wide across Undergraduate College disciplines; GR exchange is restricted to one approved Master's programme.

english_course_availability.notes: Exclusive English-taught study options available at both UG and GR levels (bilingual Paris UG track discontinued; students choose French OR English on Paris campus).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Undergraduate & Graduate English-track minimums: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL / TOEFL iBT Home Edition 100, Duolingo English Test 130, or Cambridge C1 (FCE/CAE/CPE); native English speakers exempt. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.

host_language_requirement.value: French not required for English-taught programs. For French-taught courses: UG requires TCF 400 or DELF/DALF B2; GR requires TCF 500 or DELF/DALF C1 (native French speakers exempt).

fall_term_dates.value: 2025-09-01 to 2025-12-19 (AY 2025-2026 Sem 1 classes incl. exams; Welcome Programme Aug 25–30, 2025; mandatory presence through last exam day)
fall_term_dates.notes: 2026-2027 dates not verified directly on sciencespo.fr (university calendar portal: https://www.sciencespo.fr/students/en/study/academic-affairs/university-calendar/).

spring_term_dates.value: 2026-01-24 to 2026-05-22 (AY 2025-2026 Sem 2 classes incl. exams; 2nd-yr Law School Jan 5–Apr 24; Welcome Jan 19–24, 2026)

tuition_model.notes: Partner exchange operates under bilateral institutional agreement, though neither factsheet2025-2026.pdf nor observed sciencespo.fr excerpts explicitly state incoming exchange tuition waiver terms.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Neither factsheet2025-2026.pdf nor directly observed sciencespo.fr pages publish a numeric monthly living cost range (avoiding unverified third-party Paris cost blogs).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Omitted because no official sciencespo.fr or fact-sheet monthly living cost range was observed.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Bilateral exchange students are exempt from paying the French CVEC student life contribution (obtain free exemption attestation per etudiant.gouv.fr and https://www.campusfrance.org/en/the-cvec-student-and-campus-life-contribution). Campus health center and student first-steps info at www.sciencespo.fr/students/en.html.

housing_availability.notes: Sciences Po housing portal guides incoming exchange students to external/private accommodation; campus-level guidance noted on factsheet2025-2026.pdf#page=2.

housing_notes.value: Housing support provided via Sciences Po Students website (https://www.sciencespo.fr/students/en/support/housing); regional campuses generally offer more affordable accommodation than Paris (`Useful Info. Science Po.docx`).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss exchange students must obtain a French student visa before arrival even if already enrolled in an EU university (`factsheet2025-2026.pdf#page=2`). Effective August 1, 2026, Décret n° 2026-526 increased French VLS-TS student financial proof from EUR 615/mo to EUR 877.50/month (EUR 10,530/year; 47% of gross SMIC).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Mandatory non-EU student visa rule also in data/raw/factsheets/Sciences Po/2025-2026/factsheet2025-2026.pdf#page=2.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS: minimum 5 ECTS to maximum 30 ECTS per semester (up to 60 ECTS/year). Starting Sept 2025, language courses are 4 ECTS graded Pass/Fail (`Useful Info. Science Po.docx`); strict attendance policy allows max 2 absences per class.

course_restrictions_note.value: Paris UG campus offers French OR English track (bilingual track discontinued); regional UG campuses feature specific geographical minors (max 2 campuses, 1–2 disciplines). GR students must enroll within one specific Master's programme and may add up to 2 Common Academic Curriculum courses/sem.

value: French and/or English language test results

campus_type.notes: Seven campuses: Paris (main/Saint-Guillaume) plus six UG regional campuses (Dijon, Le Havre, Menton, Nancy, Poitiers, Reims).

international_support_services.value: Student Exchanges Team, optional Welcome Programme, Health Center, and Disability Support Service.

nomination_deadlines.value: 2025-2026 cycle (`#page=1`): Autumn nomination Mar 4–26, student application Apr 2; Spring nomination Sep 23–Oct 7, student application Oct 9. Admitted students must accept offer within 15 days or forfeit spot (`Useful Info. Science Po.docx`).
